conceptual_architecture.caption: Conceptual architecture, not an empirical result. Deterministic derived views contain no independent measurements; future selective transfer remains untested.

development_learning_curves.caption: Development only. Online training metrics reflect changing weights and train-mode augmentation/dropout; validation metrics use the fixed epoch checkpoint. XResNet validation uses max over seven crops.

locked_calibration.caption: Locked test, prespecified representative seed101 for legibility; no probability averaging or recalibration. Calibration uses ten fixed equal-width bins.

locked_confusion_matrices.caption: Seed101 only; each threshold selected using fold9F1 before lock. Counts are recordings, not independent patients. Reporting-only revision: titles wrapped after visual review; all numerical values unchanged.

locked_macro_comparison.caption: Patient-cluster95% conditional intervals. Same test participants; mean seed-wise metrics, no ensemble. Published0.928 is not plotted as our result.

locked_parameter_compute_comparison.caption: MACs exclude FFT, normalization and pooling. XResNet includes seven inference crops. Training time measured on common CPU and concurrent paired-seed processes.

locked_per_label_comparison.caption: Locked test per-label ranking; mean metrics across seeds. AP prevalence baselines shown explicitly.
